case.summary: Cardholder C09988 reported an unauthorized online transaction of $59.67 (transaction 3534820) on card C09988-K1. The charge was conducted online via device D000431, which was marked as a new device for this account. Analysis of holder history showed no established recurring charge pattern or positive evidence of cardholder authorization. While the card is not affiliated with a detected fraud ring and the model score was moderate at 0.329, the lack of cardholder authorization alongside a new device confirms the dispute. The alert is confirmed as card-not-present new device fraud with an exposure of $59.67, resulting in a card block and case creation.
